title: Completely Positive and Trace Preserving Schemes with Tensor Train Compression for the Lindblad Equation
summary: We propose a family of low-rank, completely positive and trace preserving schemes for the Lindblad equation, a common model for open quantum systems. Low-rank representation is employed at two levels: the density matrix is factorized into the product of tall-skinny matrices, and the columns of these matrices are further represented using the tensor train (TT) format, also know as matrix product states (MPS).
